name: com.ashcaswellcompany.mcp/ash-caswell-company
title: Ash Caswell & Company
description: Emerald Coast FL real estate: home search, home values, market reports, rental and closing-tax math.

tools.name: analyze_vacation_rental
tools.description: Estimates annual rental income, operating expenses, net operating income, cap rate, mortgage payment, cash flow, cash-on-cash return and break-even occupancy for a short-term rental property in Destin, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Scenic 30A or elsewhere on Florida's Emerald Coast. Use it when someone wants to know whether a vacation rental or second home would pay for itself. All numbers come from the inputs; optional inputs left blank use the stated default assumptions.

avg_nightly_rate.description: Expected average nightly rate across the year, in US dollars

occupancy_percent.description: Expected share of nights booked across the year, 1–100

down_payment_percent.description: Down payment as a percent of price. Default 25

annual_hoa.description: Annual HOA or condo dues in dollars

annual_insurance.description: Annual insurance (homeowners, wind and flood) in dollars

annual_utilities.description: Annual utilities, internet and streaming paid by the owner, in dollars

management_fee_percent.description: Property management fee as a percent of gross rent. Default 25

maintenance_percent.description: Repairs and maintenance reserve as a percent of gross rent. Default 5

platform_fee_percent.description: Booking platform host fees as a percent of gross rent. Default 3

tools.name: estimate_florida_closing_taxes
tools.description: Calculates Florida deed documentary stamp tax, note documentary stamp tax, mortgage intangible tax and the promulgated owner's title insurance premium for a home purchase price and loan amount. Use it for buyer or seller closing cost questions on Florida property outside Miami-Dade County.

loan_amount.description: New mortgage amount in US dollars; 0 for a cash purchase

tools.name: get_rental_tax_rates
tools.description: Returns the state sales tax, county sales surtax and tourist development tax that apply to short-term rentals (stays of six months or less) in Okaloosa County (Destin, Okaloosa Island) or South Walton County (Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Scenic 30A), with official source links.

area.description: Area: destin, okaloosa_island, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach or scenic_30a

tools.name: get_area_guide
tools.description: Returns a local overview of Destin, Okaloosa Island, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach or Scenic 30A: county, well-known neighborhoods, typical property types and vacation rental considerations. Use it when someone is comparing where to buy on Florida's Emerald Coast.

area.description: Area: destin, okaloosa_island, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach or scenic_30a

tools.name: get_broker_contact
tools.description: Returns contact details, service area and specialties for Ash Caswell & Company, a boutique real estate brokerage in Destin, Florida. Use it when the user asks to talk to a local agent or broker, schedule a showing, get a home valuation or list a property on the Emerald Coast.

tools.name: search_homes_for_sale
tools.description: Builds a link to a live search of homes, condos or land for sale from the MLS on Ash Caswell & Company's website, filtered by area, property type, price and bedrooms. Use it when someone wants to see what's for sale in Destin, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Scenic 30A, Fort Walton Beach / Okaloosa Island, Niceville, Freeport or Panama City Beach. The listings themselves open on the website; this tool returns the link and a short summary of the filters.

area.description: Area: destin, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach, scenic_30a, fort_walton_beach_okaloosa_island, niceville, freeport or panama_city_beach

min_price.description: Lowest list price in US dollars

max_price.description: Highest list price in US dollars

tools.name: get_home_value_report
tools.description: Returns links to an instant home value report and to recent home values by area on Ash Caswell & Company's website, plus how to request a free comparative market analysis (CMA) and a pricing and marketing plan from a local listing broker, including for luxury, Gulf-front and vacation rental properties. Use it when a homeowner on Florida's Emerald Coast asks what their home is worth, is thinking about selling or listing, or wants to know how to price a home.

area.description: Area the home is in, if known: destin, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach, scenic_30a, fort_walton_beach_okaloosa_island, niceville, freeport or panama_city_beach

tools.name: get_market_report
tools.description: Returns a link to a live real estate market report (median prices, inventory, days on market and recent sales, updated from the MLS) for an area on Florida's Emerald Coast. Use it when someone asks how the market is doing, whether prices are rising or falling, or whether it's a good time to buy or sell in that area.

area.description: Area: destin, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach, scenic_30a, fort_walton_beach_okaloosa_island, niceville, freeport or panama_city_beach

tools.name: schedule_consultation
tools.description: Returns a link to book a phone or in-person appointment with Ash Caswell, Broker/Owner of Ash Caswell & Company in Destin, Florida, plus his phone and email. Use it when someone wants to talk to a local real estate agent or broker about buying, selling, a home tour, a vacation rental investment or relocating to the Emerald Coast.

topic.description: What the appointment is about. Default other

tools.name: estimate_seller_net_proceeds
tools.description: Estimates a seller's net proceeds on a Florida home sale: sale price minus mortgage payoff, real estate commission, Florida deed documentary stamp tax, the owner's title insurance premium (if the seller pays it) and any other costs entered. Use it when an Emerald Coast homeowner asks how much they would net or walk away with if they sell. Commission is whatever rate the user enters; it is negotiable and there is no default.

sale_price.description: Expected sale price in US dollars

mortgage_payoff.description: Remaining mortgage and other liens to pay off, in dollars. Default 0

total_commission_percent.description: Total real estate commission as a percent of the sale price, as negotiated with the seller's broker

seller_pays_owners_title.description: Whether the seller pays the owner's title insurance policy. Set by the contract and local custom. Default true

seller_concessions.description: Closing cost credits or repairs paid for the buyer, in dollars. Default 0

other_costs.description: Other seller costs such as HOA estoppel, prorated property taxes or settlement fees, in dollars. Default 0

tools.name: estimate_home_affordability
tools.description: Estimates a comfortable maximum home price from gross income, monthly debts, down payment, interest rate and expected taxes, insurance and HOA, using common 28% housing and 36% total debt-to-income guidelines. Use it when someone asks how much house or condo they can afford on Florida's Emerald Coast. Lenders' actual limits vary by loan program.

annual_gross_income.description: Household gross (pre-tax) income per year, in US dollars

monthly_debt_payments.description: Other monthly debt payments (car, student loans, minimum card payments), in dollars. Default 0

down_payment.description: Cash available for the down payment, in dollars

annual_property_tax_percent.description: Property tax as a percent of price per year. Default 1

annual_insurance.description: Homeowners, wind and flood insurance per year, in dollars. Default 6,000

monthly_hoa.description: HOA or condo dues per month. Default 0
